description: Beautiful apartment ideally located in the 10th arrondissement in the heart of Paris, on the Grands Boulevards, emblematic and lively district of the capital, 20 minutes walk from the Louvre and the Opera. Accommodating up to 8 guests, it is perfect for a family or group of friends wishing to enjoy the comfort of a spacious accommodation and its privileged location to discover and soak up Parisian life.The spaceApartment located on the second floor of a building (no elevator, access is via stairs), designed to accommodate up to 8 people. It has: - 3 private bedrooms, each with a queen size double bed - a spacious living room with a sofa that converts into a double bed - a full bathroom with toilet - a shower room - a separate toilet - an open kitchen equipped with a central island serving as a dining area Thanks to the privileged location of the accommodation, in the 10th arrondissement, you will find yourself just a few minutes, on foot or by metro, from many places of interest in Paris and its surroundings. Here are a few examples: ★ 15-minute walk from Opéra Garnier ★ 20-minute walk or 10-minute metro ride from the Louvre Museum and the Tuileries Gardens★ 15 minutes by metro from the George Pompidou Center and the Marais district, ideal for strolling through the streets and having a drink on the terrace ★ 15 minutes by metro from the Trocadero and the Eiffel Tower ★ 25 minutes by metro from Sacré-Cœur and Montmartre ★ 15 minutes by metro from the Champs Élysées and Arc de Triomphe ★ 50 minutes by transport from Disneyland ★ 1 hour by transport from the Palace of VersaillesGuest accessYou'll have the entire place to yourselfOther things to notePlease note: façade renovation work is currently being carried out on the building during the week, during the day only.
